SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(p.product_category_name, '__unknown__'::text) AS category_key,
    p.product_category_name,
    t.product_category_name_english,
    COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name, 'Unknown category'::text) AS category_label,
    p.product_category_name IS NULL AS is_missing_category,
    p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL AND t.product_category_name IS NULL AS is_untranslated_category
   FROM products p
     LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name;

SELECT p.product_id,
    p.product_category_name,
    p.product_name_lenght,
    p.product_description_lenght,
    p.product_photos_qty,
    p.product_weight_g,
    p.product_length_cm,
    p.product_height_cm,
    p.product_width_cm,
    COALESCE(p.product_category_name, '__unknown__'::text) AS category_key,
    c.category_label
   FROM products p
     JOIN olist_analytics.v_categories c ON c.category_key = COALESCE(p.product_category_name, '__unknown__'::text);

SELECT seller_id,
    seller_zip_code_prefix,
    seller_city,
    seller_state
   FROM sellers;

SELECT DISTINCT customer_state
   FROM customers;

SELECT d::date AS date,
    EXTRACT(year FROM d)::integer AS year,
    EXTRACT(quarter FROM d)::integer AS quarter,
    EXTRACT(month FROM d)::integer AS month_number,
    to_char(d, 'Mon'::text) AS month_name,
    date_trunc('month'::text, d)::date AS month_start,
    to_char(d, 'YYYY-MM'::text) AS year_month,
    (EXTRACT(year FROM d) * 100::numeric + EXTRACT(month FROM d))::integer AS year_month_sort
   FROM generate_series(( SELECT date_trunc('year'::text, min(orders.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS date_trunc
           FROM orders), ( SELECT date_trunc('year'::text, max(orders.order_purchase_timestamp)) + '1 year'::interval - '1 day'::interval
           FROM orders), '1 day'::interval) g(d);

WITH items AS (
         SELECT order_items.order_id,
            count(*) AS item_rows,
            sum(order_items.price) AS item_sales_brl,
            sum(order_items.freight_value) AS freight_brl
           FROM order_items
          GROUP BY order_items.order_id
        ), payments AS (
         SELECT order_payments.order_id,
            count(*) AS payment_rows,
            sum(order_payments.payment_value) AS payment_value_brl
           FROM order_payments
          GROUP BY order_payments.order_id
        ), reviews AS (
         SELECT order_reviews.order_id,
            count(*) AS review_rows,
            sum(order_reviews.review_score) AS review_score_sum,
            avg(order_reviews.review_score) AS avg_order_review_score
           FROM order_reviews
          GROUP BY order_reviews.order_id
        ), joined AS (
         SELECT o.order_id,
            o.customer_id,
            o.order_status,
            o.order_purchase_timestamp,
            o.order_approved_at,
            o.order_delivered_carrier_date,
            o.order_delivered_customer_date,
            o.order_estimated_delivery_date,
            c.customer_unique_id,
            c.customer_state,
            o.order_purchase_timestamp::date AS purchase_date,
            date_trunc('month'::text, o.order_purchase_timestamp)::date AS purchase_month,
            COALESCE(i.item_rows, 0::bigint) AS item_rows,
            COALESCE(i.item_sales_brl, 0::numeric) AS item_sales_brl,
            COALESCE(i.freight_brl, 0::numeric) AS freight_brl,
            i.order_id IS NOT NULL AS has_items,
            COALESCE(p.payment_rows, 0::bigint) AS payment_rows,
            COALESCE(p.payment_value_brl, 0::numeric) AS payment_value_brl,
            p.order_id IS NOT NULL AS has_payment,
            COALESCE(r.review_rows, 0::bigint) AS review_rows,
            COALESCE(r.review_score_sum, 0::bigint) AS review_score_sum,
            r.avg_order_review_score,
            COALESCE(o.order_status = 'delivered'::text AND o.order_delivered_customer_date >= o.order_purchase_timestamp, false) AS eligible_delivery
           FROM orders o
             JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
             LEFT JOIN items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
             LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
             LEFT JOIN reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
        )
 SELECT order_id,
    customer_id,
    order_status,
    order_purchase_timestamp,
    order_approved_at,
    order_delivered_carrier_date,
    order_delivered_customer_date,
    order_estimated_delivery_date,
    customer_unique_id,
    customer_state,
    purchase_date,
    purchase_month,
    item_rows,
    item_sales_brl,
    freight_brl,
    has_items,
    payment_rows,
    payment_value_brl,
    has_payment,
    review_rows,
    review_score_sum,
    avg_order_review_score,
    eligible_delivery,
        CASE
            WHEN eligible_delivery THEN EXTRACT(epoch FROM order_delivered_customer_date - order_purchase_timestamp) / 86400.0
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS delivery_days,
        CASE
            WHEN eligible_delivery THEN EXTRACT(epoch FROM order_delivered_customer_date - order_estimated_delivery_date) / 86400.0
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS delay_days,
        CASE
            WHEN eligible_delivery THEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date
            ELSE NULL::boolean
        END AS is_late,
        CASE
            WHEN has_items AND has_payment THEN payment_value_brl - item_sales_brl - freight_brl
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS payment_difference_brl
   FROM joined j;

SELECT i.order_id,
    i.order_item_id,
    i.product_id,
    i.seller_id,
    i.shipping_limit_date,
    i.price,
    i.freight_value,
    o.customer_id,
    c.customer_unique_id,
    c.customer_state,
    o.order_status,
    o.order_purchase_timestamp::date AS purchase_date,
    date_trunc('month'::text, o.order_purchase_timestamp)::date AS purchase_month,
    COALESCE(p.product_category_name, '__unknown__'::text) AS category_key
   FROM order_items i
     JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
     JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
     JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id;

SELECT p.order_id,
    p.payment_sequential,
    p.payment_type,
    p.payment_installments,
    p.payment_value,
    c.customer_unique_id,
    c.customer_state,
    o.order_status,
    o.order_purchase_timestamp::date AS purchase_date
   FROM order_payments p
     JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id
     JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id;

WITH rfm AS (
         SELECT v_orders.customer_unique_id,
            '2018-09-01'::date AS reference_date,
            max(v_orders.purchase_date) AS last_purchase_date,
            '2018-09-01'::date - max(v_orders.purchase_date) AS recency_days,
            count(*) AS frequency,
            sum(v_orders.payment_value_brl) AS monetary_brl
           FROM olist_analytics.v_orders
          WHERE v_orders.order_status = 'delivered'::text AND v_orders.has_payment AND v_orders.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-09-01'::date
          GROUP BY v_orders.customer_unique_id
        ), scored AS (
         SELECT rfm.customer_unique_id,
            rfm.reference_date,
            rfm.last_purchase_date,
            rfm.recency_days,
            rfm.frequency,
            rfm.monetary_brl,
                CASE
                    WHEN rfm.recency_days <= 30 THEN 5
                    WHEN rfm.recency_days <= 90 THEN 4
                    WHEN rfm.recency_days <= 180 THEN 3
                    WHEN rfm.recency_days <= 365 THEN 2
                    ELSE 1
                END AS r_score,
                CASE
                    WHEN rfm.frequency = 1 THEN 1
                    WHEN rfm.frequency = 2 THEN 3
                    ELSE 5
                END AS f_score,
            ntile(5) OVER (ORDER BY rfm.monetary_brl, rfm.customer_unique_id) AS m_score
           FROM rfm
        )
 SELECT customer_unique_id,
    reference_date,
    last_purchase_date,
    recency_days,
    frequency,
    monetary_brl,
    r_score,
    f_score,
    m_score,
        CASE
            WHEN r_score >= 4 AND f_score >= 3 AND m_score >= 4 THEN 'High value active'::text
            WHEN r_score <= 2 THEN 'Lapsed'::text
            WHEN frequency = 1 THEN 'Single purchase'::text
            ELSE 'Other repeat'::text
        END AS segment
   FROM scored;

WITH people AS (
         SELECT v_orders.customer_unique_id,
            min(v_orders.purchase_date) AS first_purchase_date,
            max(v_orders.purchase_date) AS last_purchase_date,
            count(*) AS lifetime_orders,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE v_orders.has_payment) AS lifetime_paid_orders,
            sum(v_orders.item_sales_brl) AS lifetime_item_sales_brl,
            sum(v_orders.payment_value_brl) AS lifetime_payment_value_brl
           FROM olist_analytics.v_orders
          GROUP BY v_orders.customer_unique_id
        )
 SELECT p.customer_unique_id,
    p.first_purchase_date,
    p.last_purchase_date,
    p.lifetime_orders,
    p.lifetime_paid_orders,
    p.lifetime_item_sales_brl,
    p.lifetime_payment_value_brl,
    date_trunc('month'::text, p.first_purchase_date::timestamp with time zone)::date AS acquisition_month,
    p.lifetime_orders > 1 AS is_repeat_customer,
    r.reference_date,
    r.recency_days,
    r.frequency AS rfm_frequency,
    r.monetary_brl AS rfm_monetary_brl,
    r.r_score,
    r.f_score,
    r.m_score,
    COALESCE(r.segment, 'Not eligible'::text) AS rfm_segment
   FROM people p
     LEFT JOIN olist_analytics.v_rfm r USING (customer_unique_id);

WITH monthly AS (
         SELECT v_orders.purchase_month AS month,
            count(*) AS total_orders,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE v_orders.has_payment) AS orders_with_payment,
            sum(v_orders.item_sales_brl) AS item_sales_brl,
            sum(v_orders.freight_brl) AS freight_brl,
            sum(v_orders.payment_value_brl) AS payment_value_brl
           FROM olist_analytics.v_orders
          GROUP BY v_orders.purchase_month
        ), calendar AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT v_date.month_start AS month
           FROM olist_analytics.v_date
          WHERE v_date.month_start >= (( SELECT min(monthly.month) AS min
                   FROM monthly)) AND v_date.month_start <= (( SELECT max(monthly.month) AS max
                   FROM monthly))
        ), filled AS (
         SELECT c.month,
            COALESCE(m.total_orders, 0::bigint) AS total_orders,
            COALESCE(m.orders_with_payment, 0::bigint) AS orders_with_payment,
            COALESCE(m.item_sales_brl, 0::numeric) AS item_sales_brl,
            COALESCE(m.freight_brl, 0::numeric) AS freight_brl,
            COALESCE(m.payment_value_brl, 0::numeric) AS payment_value_brl,
            c.month = ANY (ARRAY[( SELECT min(monthly.month) AS min
                   FROM monthly), ( SELECT max(monthly.month) AS max
                   FROM monthly)]) AS is_boundary_month
           FROM calendar c
             LEFT JOIN monthly m USING (month)
        ), lagged AS (
         SELECT f.month,
            f.total_orders,
            f.orders_with_payment,
            f.item_sales_brl,
            f.freight_brl,
            f.payment_value_brl,
            f.is_boundary_month,
            lag(f.item_sales_brl) OVER (ORDER BY f.month) AS previous_item_sales_brl
           FROM filled f
        )
 SELECT month,
    total_orders,
    orders_with_payment,
    item_sales_brl,
    freight_brl,
    payment_value_brl,
    is_boundary_month,
    previous_item_sales_brl,
    payment_value_brl / NULLIF(orders_with_payment, 0)::numeric AS aov_brl,
    100.0 * (item_sales_brl - previous_item_sales_brl) / NULLIF(previous_item_sales_brl, 0::numeric) AS item_sales_growth_pct,
    sum(item_sales_brl) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_item_sales_brl
   FROM lagged l;

WITH seller_items AS (
         SELECT order_items.order_id,
            order_items.seller_id,
            count(*) AS item_rows,
            sum(order_items.price) AS seller_item_sales_brl,
            sum(order_items.freight_value) AS seller_freight_brl,
            min(order_items.shipping_limit_date) AS earliest_shipping_limit
           FROM order_items
          GROUP BY order_items.order_id, order_items.seller_id
        )
 SELECT s.order_id,
    s.seller_id,
    s.item_rows,
    s.seller_item_sales_brl,
    s.seller_freight_brl,
    s.earliest_shipping_limit,
    o.purchase_date,
    o.purchase_month,
    o.customer_unique_id,
    o.customer_state,
    o.order_status,
    o.eligible_delivery,
    o.delivery_days,
    o.delay_days,
    o.is_late,
    o.avg_order_review_score,
    COALESCE(o.order_delivered_carrier_date >= o.order_purchase_timestamp, false) AS eligible_shipping_proxy,
        CASE
            WHEN o.order_delivered_carrier_date >= o.order_purchase_timestamp THEN o.order_delivered_carrier_date <= s.earliest_shipping_limit
            ELSE NULL::boolean
        END AS met_shipping_limit_proxy
   FROM seller_items s
     JOIN olist_analytics.v_orders o USING (order_id);

WITH scores AS (
         SELECT v_seller_orders.seller_id,
            count(*) AS seller_orders,
            sum(v_seller_orders.item_rows) AS item_rows,
            sum(v_seller_orders.seller_item_sales_brl) AS item_sales_brl,
            sum(v_seller_orders.seller_freight_brl) AS freight_brl,
            sum(v_seller_orders.seller_item_sales_brl) / count(*)::numeric AS seller_order_item_aov_brl,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE v_seller_orders.eligible_delivery) AS eligible_delivered_orders,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE v_seller_orders.is_late) AS late_orders,
            100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE v_seller_orders.is_late)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE v_seller_orders.eligible_delivery), 0)::numeric AS late_rate_pct,
            avg(v_seller_orders.delivery_days) AS avg_delivery_days,
            count(v_seller_orders.avg_order_review_score) AS reviewed_seller_orders,
            avg(v_seller_orders.avg_order_review_score) AS avg_order_review_score,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE v_seller_orders.eligible_shipping_proxy) AS eligible_shipping_orders,
            100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE v_seller_orders.met_shipping_limit_proxy)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE v_seller_orders.eligible_shipping_proxy), 0)::numeric AS shipping_limit_met_pct_proxy
           FROM olist_analytics.v_seller_orders
          GROUP BY v_seller_orders.seller_id
        ), baseline AS (
         SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE v_orders.is_late)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE v_orders.eligible_delivery), 0)::numeric AS late_rate
           FROM olist_analytics.v_orders
        )
 SELECT sc.seller_id,
    sc.seller_orders,
    sc.item_rows,
    sc.item_sales_brl,
    sc.freight_brl,
    sc.seller_order_item_aov_brl,
    sc.eligible_delivered_orders,
    sc.late_orders,
    sc.late_rate_pct,
    sc.avg_delivery_days,
    sc.reviewed_seller_orders,
    sc.avg_order_review_score,
    sc.eligible_shipping_orders,
    sc.shipping_limit_met_pct_proxy,
    s.seller_city,
    s.seller_state,
    rank() OVER (ORDER BY sc.item_sales_brl DESC) AS sales_rank,
        CASE
            WHEN sc.eligible_delivered_orders < 30 THEN 'Small sample'::text
            WHEN sc.late_rate_pct > b.late_rate THEN 'Above overall late-rate baseline'::text
            ELSE 'At or below overall late-rate baseline'::text
        END AS delivery_monitoring_flag
   FROM scores sc
     JOIN sellers s USING (seller_id)
     CROSS JOIN baseline b;

WITH category_items AS (
         SELECT v_items.order_id,
            v_items.category_key,
            count(*) AS item_rows,
            sum(v_items.price) AS category_item_sales_brl,
            sum(v_items.freight_value) AS category_freight_brl
           FROM olist_analytics.v_items
          GROUP BY v_items.order_id, v_items.category_key
        )
 SELECT i.order_id,
    i.category_key,
    i.item_rows,
    i.category_item_sales_brl,
    i.category_freight_brl,
    o.purchase_date,
    o.customer_unique_id,
    o.customer_state,
    o.order_status,
    o.eligible_delivery,
    o.delivery_days,
    o.delay_days,
    o.is_late,
    o.avg_order_review_score
   FROM category_items i
     JOIN olist_analytics.v_orders o USING (order_id);

WITH eligible AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT v_orders.customer_unique_id,
            v_orders.purchase_month
           FROM olist_analytics.v_orders
          WHERE v_orders.order_status = 'delivered'::text AND v_orders.purchase_date < '2018-09-01'::date
        ), first_month AS (
         SELECT eligible.customer_unique_id,
            min(eligible.purchase_month) AS cohort_month
           FROM eligible
          GROUP BY eligible.customer_unique_id
        ), sizes AS (
         SELECT first_month.cohort_month,
            count(*) AS cohort_size
           FROM first_month
          GROUP BY first_month.cohort_month
        ), active AS (
         SELECT f.cohort_month,
            e.purchase_month,
            count(*) AS active_customers
           FROM eligible e
             JOIN first_month f USING (customer_unique_id)
          GROUP BY f.cohort_month, e.purchase_month
        ), grid AS (
         SELECT s.cohort_month,
            s.cohort_size,
            g_1.activity_month::date AS activity_month
           FROM sizes s
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(s.cohort_month::timestamp without time zone, '2018-08-01 00:00:00'::timestamp without time zone, '1 mon'::interval) g_1(activity_month)
        )
 SELECT g.cohort_month,
    g.activity_month,
    (12::numeric * (EXTRACT(year FROM g.activity_month) - EXTRACT(year FROM g.cohort_month)) + EXTRACT(month FROM g.activity_month) - EXTRACT(month FROM g.cohort_month))::integer AS month_offset,
    g.cohort_size,
    COALESCE(a.active_customers, 0::bigint) AS active_customers,
    100.0 * COALESCE(a.active_customers, 0::bigint)::numeric / NULLIF(g.cohort_size, 0)::numeric AS retention_pct,
    '2018-09-01'::date AS observation_end
   FROM grid g
     LEFT JOIN active a ON a.cohort_month = g.cohort_month AND a.purchase_month = g.activity_month;

SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(p.product_category_name, '__unknown__'::text) AS category_key,
    p.product_category_name,
    t.product_category_name_english,
    COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name, 'Unknown category'::text) AS category_label,
    p.product_category_name IS NULL AS is_missing_category,
    p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL AND t.product_category_name IS NULL AS is_untranslated_category
   FROM products p
     LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name;

SELECT p.product_id,
    p.product_category_name,
    p.product_name_lenght,
    p.product_description_lenght,
    p.product_photos_qty,
    p.product_weight_g,
    p.product_length_cm,
    p.product_height_cm,
    p.product_width_cm,
    COALESCE(p.product_category_name, '__unknown__'::text) AS category_key,
    c.category_label
   FROM products p
     JOIN olist_analytics.v_categories c ON c.category_key = COALESCE(p.product_category_name, '__unknown__'::text);

SELECT seller_id,
    seller_zip_code_prefix,
    seller_city,
    seller_state
   FROM sellers;

SELECT DISTINCT customer_state
   FROM customers;

WITH scores AS (
         SELECT v_seller_orders.seller_id,
            count(*) AS seller_orders,
            sum(v_seller_orders.item_rows) AS item_rows,
            sum(v_seller_orders.seller_item_sales_brl) AS item_sales_brl,
            sum(v_seller_orders.seller_freight_brl) AS freight_brl,
            sum(v_seller_orders.seller_item_sales_brl) / count(*)::numeric AS seller_order_item_aov_brl,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE v_seller_orders.eligible_delivery) AS eligible_delivered_orders,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE v_seller_orders.is_late) AS late_orders,
            100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE v_seller_orders.is_late)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE v_seller_orders.eligible_delivery), 0)::numeric AS late_rate_pct,
            avg(v_seller_orders.delivery_days) AS avg_delivery_days,
            count(v_seller_orders.avg_order_review_score) AS reviewed_seller_orders,
            avg(v_seller_orders.avg_order_review_score) AS avg_order_review_score,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE v_seller_orders.eligible_shipping_proxy) AS eligible_shipping_orders,
            100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE v_seller_orders.met_shipping_limit_proxy)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE v_seller_orders.eligible_shipping_proxy), 0)::numeric AS shipping_limit_met_pct_proxy
           FROM olist_analytics.v_seller_orders
          GROUP BY v_seller_orders.seller_id
        ), baseline AS (
         SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE v_orders.is_late)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE v_orders.eligible_delivery), 0)::numeric AS late_rate
           FROM olist_analytics.v_orders
        )
 SELECT sc.seller_id,
    sc.seller_orders,
    sc.item_rows,
    sc.item_sales_brl,
    sc.freight_brl,
    sc.seller_order_item_aov_brl,
    sc.eligible_delivered_orders,
    sc.late_orders,
    sc.late_rate_pct,
    sc.avg_delivery_days,
    sc.reviewed_seller_orders,
    sc.avg_order_review_score,
    sc.eligible_shipping_orders,
    sc.shipping_limit_met_pct_proxy,
    s.seller_city,
    s.seller_state,
    rank() OVER (ORDER BY sc.item_sales_brl DESC) AS sales_rank,
        CASE
            WHEN sc.eligible_delivered_orders < 30 THEN 'Small sample'::text
            WHEN sc.late_rate_pct > b.late_rate THEN 'Above overall late-rate baseline'::text
            ELSE 'At or below overall late-rate baseline'::text
        END AS delivery_monitoring_flag
   FROM scores sc
     JOIN sellers s USING (seller_id)
     CROSS JOIN baseline b;

WITH category_items AS (
         SELECT v_items.order_id,
            v_items.category_key,
            count(*) AS item_rows,
            sum(v_items.price) AS category_item_sales_brl,
            sum(v_items.freight_value) AS category_freight_brl
           FROM olist_analytics.v_items
          GROUP BY v_items.order_id, v_items.category_key
        )
 SELECT i.order_id,
    i.category_key,
    i.item_rows,
    i.category_item_sales_brl,
    i.category_freight_brl,
    o.purchase_date,
    o.customer_unique_id,
    o.customer_state,
    o.order_status,
    o.eligible_delivery,
    o.delivery_days,
    o.delay_days,
    o.is_late,
    o.avg_order_review_score
   FROM category_items i
     JOIN olist_analytics.v_orders o USING (order_id);

WITH eligible AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT v_orders.customer_unique_id,
            v_orders.purchase_month
           FROM olist_analytics.v_orders
          WHERE v_orders.order_status = 'delivered'::text AND v_orders.purchase_date < '2018-09-01'::date
        ), first_month AS (
         SELECT eligible.customer_unique_id,
            min(eligible.purchase_month) AS cohort_month
           FROM eligible
          GROUP BY eligible.customer_unique_id
        ), sizes AS (
         SELECT first_month.cohort_month,
            count(*) AS cohort_size
           FROM first_month
          GROUP BY first_month.cohort_month
        ), active AS (
         SELECT f.cohort_month,
            e.purchase_month,
            count(*) AS active_customers
           FROM eligible e
             JOIN first_month f USING (customer_unique_id)
          GROUP BY f.cohort_month, e.purchase_month
        ), grid AS (
         SELECT s.cohort_month,
            s.cohort_size,
            g_1.activity_month::date AS activity_month
           FROM sizes s
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(s.cohort_month::timestamp without time zone, '2018-08-01 00:00:00'::timestamp without time zone, '1 mon'::interval) g_1(activity_month)
        )
 SELECT g.cohort_month,
    g.activity_month,
    (12::numeric * (EXTRACT(year FROM g.activity_month) - EXTRACT(year FROM g.cohort_month)) + EXTRACT(month FROM g.activity_month) - EXTRACT(month FROM g.cohort_month))::integer AS month_offset,
    g.cohort_size,
    COALESCE(a.active_customers, 0::bigint) AS active_customers,
    100.0 * COALESCE(a.active_customers, 0::bigint)::numeric / NULLIF(g.cohort_size, 0)::numeric AS retention_pct,
    '2018-09-01'::date AS observation_end
   FROM grid g
     LEFT JOIN active a ON a.cohort_month = g.cohort_month AND a.purchase_month = g.activity_month;

SELECT d::date AS date,
    EXTRACT(year FROM d)::integer AS year,
    EXTRACT(quarter FROM d)::integer AS quarter,
    EXTRACT(month FROM d)::integer AS month_number,
    to_char(d, 'Mon'::text) AS month_name,
    date_trunc('month'::text, d)::date AS month_start,
    to_char(d, 'YYYY-MM'::text) AS year_month,
    (EXTRACT(year FROM d) * 100::numeric + EXTRACT(month FROM d))::integer AS year_month_sort
   FROM generate_series(( SELECT date_trunc('year'::text, min(orders.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS date_trunc
           FROM orders), ( SELECT date_trunc('year'::text, max(orders.order_purchase_timestamp)) + '1 year'::interval - '1 day'::interval
           FROM orders), '1 day'::interval) g(d);

WITH items AS (
         SELECT order_items.order_id,
            count(*) AS item_rows,
            sum(order_items.price) AS item_sales_brl,
            sum(order_items.freight_value) AS freight_brl
           FROM order_items
          GROUP BY order_items.order_id
        ), payments AS (
         SELECT order_payments.order_id,
            count(*) AS payment_rows,
            sum(order_payments.payment_value) AS payment_value_brl
           FROM order_payments
          GROUP BY order_payments.order_id
        ), reviews AS (
         SELECT order_reviews.order_id,
            count(*) AS review_rows,
            sum(order_reviews.review_score) AS review_score_sum,
            avg(order_reviews.review_score) AS avg_order_review_score
           FROM order_reviews
          GROUP BY order_reviews.order_id
        ), joined AS (
         SELECT o.order_id,
            o.customer_id,
            o.order_status,
            o.order_purchase_timestamp,
            o.order_approved_at,
            o.order_delivered_carrier_date,
            o.order_delivered_customer_date,
            o.order_estimated_delivery_date,
            c.customer_unique_id,
            c.customer_state,
            o.order_purchase_timestamp::date AS purchase_date,
            date_trunc('month'::text, o.order_purchase_timestamp)::date AS purchase_month,
            COALESCE(i.item_rows, 0::bigint) AS item_rows,
            COALESCE(i.item_sales_brl, 0::numeric) AS item_sales_brl,
            COALESCE(i.freight_brl, 0::numeric) AS freight_brl,
            i.order_id IS NOT NULL AS has_items,
            COALESCE(p.payment_rows, 0::bigint) AS payment_rows,
            COALESCE(p.payment_value_brl, 0::numeric) AS payment_value_brl,
            p.order_id IS NOT NULL AS has_payment,
            COALESCE(r.review_rows, 0::bigint) AS review_rows,
            COALESCE(r.review_score_sum, 0::bigint) AS review_score_sum,
            r.avg_order_review_score,
            COALESCE(o.order_status = 'delivered'::text AND o.order_delivered_customer_date >= o.order_purchase_timestamp, false) AS eligible_delivery
           FROM orders o
             JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
             LEFT JOIN items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
             LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
             LEFT JOIN reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
        )
 SELECT order_id,
    customer_id,
    order_status,
    order_purchase_timestamp,
    order_approved_at,
    order_delivered_carrier_date,
    order_delivered_customer_date,
    order_estimated_delivery_date,
    customer_unique_id,
    customer_state,
    purchase_date,
    purchase_month,
    item_rows,
    item_sales_brl,
    freight_brl,
    has_items,
    payment_rows,
    payment_value_brl,
    has_payment,
    review_rows,
    review_score_sum,
    avg_order_review_score,
    eligible_delivery,
        CASE
            WHEN eligible_delivery THEN EXTRACT(epoch FROM order_delivered_customer_date - order_purchase_timestamp) / 86400.0
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS delivery_days,
        CASE
            WHEN eligible_delivery THEN EXTRACT(epoch FROM order_delivered_customer_date - order_estimated_delivery_date) / 86400.0
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS delay_days,
        CASE
            WHEN eligible_delivery THEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date
            ELSE NULL::boolean
        END AS is_late,
        CASE
            WHEN has_items AND has_payment THEN payment_value_brl - item_sales_brl - freight_brl
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS payment_difference_brl
   FROM joined j;

SELECT i.order_id,
    i.order_item_id,
    i.product_id,
    i.seller_id,
    i.shipping_limit_date,
    i.price,
    i.freight_value,
    o.customer_id,
    c.customer_unique_id,
    c.customer_state,
    o.order_status,
    o.order_purchase_timestamp::date AS purchase_date,
    date_trunc('month'::text, o.order_purchase_timestamp)::date AS purchase_month,
    COALESCE(p.product_category_name, '__unknown__'::text) AS category_key
   FROM order_items i
     JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
     JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
     JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id;

SELECT p.order_id,
    p.payment_sequential,
    p.payment_type,
    p.payment_installments,
    p.payment_value,
    c.customer_unique_id,
    c.customer_state,
    o.order_status,
    o.order_purchase_timestamp::date AS purchase_date
   FROM order_payments p
     JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id
     JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id;

WITH rfm AS (
         SELECT v_orders.customer_unique_id,
            '2018-09-01'::date AS reference_date,
            max(v_orders.purchase_date) AS last_purchase_date,
            '2018-09-01'::date - max(v_orders.purchase_date) AS recency_days,
            count(*) AS frequency,
            sum(v_orders.payment_value_brl) AS monetary_brl
           FROM olist_analytics.v_orders
          WHERE v_orders.order_status = 'delivered'::text AND v_orders.has_payment AND v_orders.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-09-01'::date
          GROUP BY v_orders.customer_unique_id
        ), scored AS (
         SELECT rfm.customer_unique_id,
            rfm.reference_date,
            rfm.last_purchase_date,
            rfm.recency_days,
            rfm.frequency,
            rfm.monetary_brl,
                CASE
                    WHEN rfm.recency_days <= 30 THEN 5
                    WHEN rfm.recency_days <= 90 THEN 4
                    WHEN rfm.recency_days <= 180 THEN 3
                    WHEN rfm.recency_days <= 365 THEN 2
                    ELSE 1
                END AS r_score,
                CASE
                    WHEN rfm.frequency = 1 THEN 1
                    WHEN rfm.frequency = 2 THEN 3
                    ELSE 5
                END AS f_score,
            ntile(5) OVER (ORDER BY rfm.monetary_brl, rfm.customer_unique_id) AS m_score
           FROM rfm
        )
 SELECT customer_unique_id,
    reference_date,
    last_purchase_date,
    recency_days,
    frequency,
    monetary_brl,
    r_score,
    f_score,
    m_score,
        CASE
            WHEN r_score >= 4 AND f_score >= 3 AND m_score >= 4 THEN 'High value active'::text
            WHEN r_score <= 2 THEN 'Lapsed'::text
            WHEN frequency = 1 THEN 'Single purchase'::text
            ELSE 'Other repeat'::text
        END AS segment
   FROM scored;

WITH people AS (
         SELECT v_orders.customer_unique_id,
            min(v_orders.purchase_date) AS first_purchase_date,
            max(v_orders.purchase_date) AS last_purchase_date,
            count(*) AS lifetime_orders,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE v_orders.has_payment) AS lifetime_paid_orders,
            sum(v_orders.item_sales_brl) AS lifetime_item_sales_brl,
            sum(v_orders.payment_value_brl) AS lifetime_payment_value_brl
           FROM olist_analytics.v_orders
          GROUP BY v_orders.customer_unique_id
        )
 SELECT p.customer_unique_id,
    p.first_purchase_date,
    p.last_purchase_date,
    p.lifetime_orders,
    p.lifetime_paid_orders,
    p.lifetime_item_sales_brl,
    p.lifetime_payment_value_brl,
    date_trunc('month'::text, p.first_purchase_date::timestamp with time zone)::date AS acquisition_month,
    p.lifetime_orders > 1 AS is_repeat_customer,
    r.reference_date,
    r.recency_days,
    r.frequency AS rfm_frequency,
    r.monetary_brl AS rfm_monetary_brl,
    r.r_score,
    r.f_score,
    r.m_score,
    COALESCE(r.segment, 'Not eligible'::text) AS rfm_segment
   FROM people p
     LEFT JOIN olist_analytics.v_rfm r USING (customer_unique_id);

WITH monthly AS (
         SELECT v_orders.purchase_month AS month,
            count(*) AS total_orders,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE v_orders.has_payment) AS orders_with_payment,
            sum(v_orders.item_sales_brl) AS item_sales_brl,
            sum(v_orders.freight_brl) AS freight_brl,
            sum(v_orders.payment_value_brl) AS payment_value_brl
           FROM olist_analytics.v_orders
          GROUP BY v_orders.purchase_month
        ), calendar AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT v_date.month_start AS month
           FROM olist_analytics.v_date
          WHERE v_date.month_start >= (( SELECT min(monthly.month) AS min
                   FROM monthly)) AND v_date.month_start <= (( SELECT max(monthly.month) AS max
                   FROM monthly))
        ), filled AS (
         SELECT c.month,
            COALESCE(m.total_orders, 0::bigint) AS total_orders,
            COALESCE(m.orders_with_payment, 0::bigint) AS orders_with_payment,
            COALESCE(m.item_sales_brl, 0::numeric) AS item_sales_brl,
            COALESCE(m.freight_brl, 0::numeric) AS freight_brl,
            COALESCE(m.payment_value_brl, 0::numeric) AS payment_value_brl,
            c.month = ANY (ARRAY[( SELECT min(monthly.month) AS min
                   FROM monthly), ( SELECT max(monthly.month) AS max
                   FROM monthly)]) AS is_boundary_month
           FROM calendar c
             LEFT JOIN monthly m USING (month)
        ), lagged AS (
         SELECT f.month,
            f.total_orders,
            f.orders_with_payment,
            f.item_sales_brl,
            f.freight_brl,
            f.payment_value_brl,
            f.is_boundary_month,
            lag(f.item_sales_brl) OVER (ORDER BY f.month) AS previous_item_sales_brl
           FROM filled f
        )
 SELECT month,
    total_orders,
    orders_with_payment,
    item_sales_brl,
    freight_brl,
    payment_value_brl,
    is_boundary_month,
    previous_item_sales_brl,
    payment_value_brl / NULLIF(orders_with_payment, 0)::numeric AS aov_brl,
    100.0 * (item_sales_brl - previous_item_sales_brl) / NULLIF(previous_item_sales_brl, 0::numeric) AS item_sales_growth_pct,
    sum(item_sales_brl) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_item_sales_brl
   FROM lagged l;

WITH seller_items AS (
         SELECT order_items.order_id,
            order_items.seller_id,
            count(*) AS item_rows,
            sum(order_items.price) AS seller_item_sales_brl,
            sum(order_items.freight_value) AS seller_freight_brl,
            min(order_items.shipping_limit_date) AS earliest_shipping_limit
           FROM order_items
          GROUP BY order_items.order_id, order_items.seller_id
        )
 SELECT s.order_id,
    s.seller_id,
    s.item_rows,
    s.seller_item_sales_brl,
    s.seller_freight_brl,
    s.earliest_shipping_limit,
    o.purchase_date,
    o.purchase_month,
    o.customer_unique_id,
    o.customer_state,
    o.order_status,
    o.eligible_delivery,
    o.delivery_days,
    o.delay_days,
    o.is_late,
    o.avg_order_review_score,
    COALESCE(o.order_delivered_carrier_date >= o.order_purchase_timestamp, false) AS eligible_shipping_proxy,
        CASE
            WHEN o.order_delivered_carrier_date >= o.order_purchase_timestamp THEN o.order_delivered_carrier_date <= s.earliest_shipping_limit
            ELSE NULL::boolean
        END AS met_shipping_limit_proxy
   FROM seller_items s
     JOIN olist_analytics.v_orders o USING (order_id);
